1. The Visualization

Insert your visualization here. 
goldenRatio : Float
goldenRatio =
    1.618

Used to create the interactive legend

interactiveLegend : String -> String -> Spec
interactiveLegend field selName =
    let
        enc =
            encoding
                -- Just encode in the Y position direction to create column of marks
                << position Y
                    [ pName field
                    , pAxis [ axTitle "", axDomain False, axTicks False ]
                    ]
                << color
                    [ mSelectionCondition (selectionName selName)
                        [ mName field, mScale [ scScheme "plasma" [] ] ]
                        [ mStr "lightgrey" ]
                    ]

        sel =
            selection
                -- Project selection to all matching values in the colour channel
                << select selName seMulti [ seEncodings [ chColor ] ]
    in
    asSpec [ sel [], enc [], square [ maSize 120, maOpacity 1 ] ]

myDataVis : Spec
myDataVis =
    let
        cfg =
            configure
                << configuration (coView [ vicoStroke Nothing ])
                << configuration (coAxis [ axcoTicks False, axcoDomain False, axcoLabelAngle 0 ])

        sel =
            selection
                << select "mySelection" seInterval [ seBindScales, seEncodings [ chX ] ]

        data =
            dataFromColumns []
                << dataColumn "year" (strColumn "year" filteredTable |> strs)
                << dataColumn "co2" (numColumn "co2" filteredTable |> nums)
                << dataColumn "model" (strColumn "model" filteredTable |> strs)
                << dataColumn "fuel_type" (strColumn "fuel_type" filteredTable |> strs)
                << dataColumn "engine_capacity" (numColumn "engine_capacity" filteredTable |> nums)
                << dataColumn "manufacturer" (strColumn "manufacturer" filteredTable |> strs)
                << dataColumn "co_emissions" (numColumn "co_emissions" filteredTable |> nums)

        trans =
            transform
                << filter (fiSelection "legendSel")

        enc =
            encoding
                << position Y [ pName "co2", pQuant, pScale [ scNice niFalse, scZero True ] ]
                << position X [ pName "engine_capacity", pQuant, pAxis [ axOrient siTop, axGrid False ], pScale [ scNice niFalse, scZero False ] ]
                << size [ mName "co_emissions", mQuant ]
                << row [ fName "fuel_type", fHeader [ hdTitleFontSize 0 ] ]
                << tooltips
                    [ [ tName "manufacturer", tTitle "Manufacturer" ]
                    , [ tName "co2", tTitle "CO2" ]
                    ]
                << opacity
                    [ mSelectionCondition (selectionName "mySelection")
                        [ mNum 1 ]
                        [ mNum 0.002 ]
                    ]
                << color
                    [ mName "year"
                    , mScale [ scScheme "inferno" [] ]
                    , mLegend []
                    ]

        chartSpec =
            asSpec [ width 800, height (800 / goldenRatio), trans [], enc [], sel [], cfg [], point [ maFilled True, maSize 200, maOpacity 0.5 ] ]
    in
    toVegaLite
        [ data []
        , hConcat [ chartSpec, interactiveLegend "year" "legendSel" ]
        ]
